notes.title: Fix talent bugs, restore card shuffling mechanism
notes.content: 1. Fix talent bug 2. Restore the shuffle mechanism 3. Modify "Plant Landmines" to "Shuffle 3 mines into your opponent's draw pile (when you draw this card, it will cause 20 points of physical damage), and Disrupt the opponent's draw pile"

notes.title: Add talent system and fix bugs
notes.content:
1. Add the talent system, choose to increase the initial card, increase the blood volume, need to consume the crystal soul. Crystal Soul: It can be obtained by defeating the enemy, and the Crystal Soul will be stored forever.
2. Fix bugs when using multiple articulation techniques
3. Fix the bug that the cards are only shuffled when the hand is used up

notes.title: 3 new professions: Ninja, Mage, Shield Strike Knight and the default line mode
notes.content:
1. New 3 professions: Ninja, Mage, Shield Strike Knight, each profession has corresponding skills, initial cards
2. Start selecting interface integration. New line mode, the original mode is changed to plot mode, the default line mode is selected, the line mode has four options, namely monsters, elites, random events, and shops. When you reach nine options, you can play against the boss.

2. At the beginning of the battle, the player will first determine the order of the players, first draw two cards normally, and draw one extra card in the second.
